protocol_type: Object-dictionary-centric application-layer protocol over CAN. Communication objects (PDO / SDO / NMT / SYNC / TIME / EMCY / heartbeat) are carried over CAN frames whose identifier is the COB-ID. SDO is client/server access to the object dictionary by index and sub-index; PDO is producer/consumer real-time process data; NMT is master/slave network-state control.

communication_objects.name: PDO
communication_objects.purpose: Real-time process data; TPDO (transmit) and RPDO (receive); up to 8 bytes, mapping + transmission types.

communication_objects.name: SDO
communication_objects.purpose: Read/write an object-dictionary entry by index and sub-index; expedited / segmented / block transfer.

communication_objects.name: NMT
communication_objects.purpose: Control the device NMT state machine and error control.

communication_objects.name: SYNC
communication_objects.purpose: Network-wide synchronisation signal (default COB-ID 0x080); synchronous PDOs reference it.

sdo_transfer_protocols.name: Expedited transfer
sdo_transfer_protocols.purpose: Up to 4 data bytes carried directly in the single request/response frame (the fast common case).

sdo_transfer_protocols.name: Segmented transfer
sdo_transfer_protocols.purpose: Data larger than 4 bytes is split into 7-byte segments, each with a toggle bit.

sdo_transfer_protocols.name: Block transfer
sdo_transfer_protocols.purpose: Optional high-throughput mode transferring a sequence of segments before a single acknowledge.

pdo_transmission_types.meaning: synchronous, acyclic (on next SYNC after a change)

object_dictionary.note: Each OD entry is addressed by a 16-bit index and an 8-bit sub-index.

addressing.note: The COB-ID maps to the CAN identifier; default COB-IDs are allocated by the predefined connection set from the Node-ID.
